name: proposta_governo — mayoral government plans
description: Full text of every mayoral candidate's proposta de governo (manifesto), legally required at candidacy registration. One row per (year, estado, SQ_CANDIDATO); joins candidato on (year, estado, SQ_CANDIDATO). Covers 2012, 2016, 2020, 2024 (~65k plans); ~9,300 are image-only scans awaiting OCR (text_source).
